about: What `fast-test` runs for a change (see ~/Code/fast-test). Quick steps run on The Dragon; a wide change also runs the full suite on The Beast. The Android app isn't here: build-in-docker.sh or GitHub's Android job covers it.

steps.name: rust
steps.about: Clippy and tests of the changed crates, and of kiwi-server, which uses all the others.
steps.run: set --; for c in {crates}; do set -- "$@" -p "$c"; done; case " $* " in *' kiwi-server '*) ;; *) set -- "$@" -p kiwi-server ;; esac; cargo clippy --locked --all-targets "$@" -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked "$@"

steps.name: web
steps.about: Typecheck of the web app and the tests that import the changed files.
steps.run: cd web && { [ -d node_modules ] || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; } && npm run typecheck && set -- && for f in {files}; do set -- "$@" "${f#web/}"; done && npx vitest related --run --passWithNoTests "$@"

steps.name: automation
steps.run: cd automation && python3 -m unittest test_runner test_android test_community

full: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --locked && (cd automation && python3 -m unittest test_runner test_android test_community) && N=/cache/npm/node-v24.21.0-linux-x64 && { [ -x $N/bin/node ] || curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.21.0/node-v24.21.0-linux-x64.tar.xz | tar -xJ -C /cache/npm; } && PATH=$N/bin:$PATH && cd web && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run typecheck && npm test
